column3: “Not by hands” is rendered “without hands”; NASB adds “continued.”
“As one” is rendered “all at the same time,” and “any place was not found for them” “not a trace of them was found.”
“Over all that dwell” is rendered “wherever … dwell”; “sons of humankind” is rendered “sons of men.”
NASB restructures the comparison with “inasmuch as … so.”
“Firmness” is rendered “toughness,” and “clay of clay” “common clay.”
“Offspring of humankind” is rendered “seed of men,” “mixing they will be” “combine with one another,” and “clinging” “adhere.”
“After this” is rendered “in the future,” and “certain” “true.”
“Made great” is rendered “promoted,” and “chief of prefects” “chief prefect.”
“The gate of the king” is rendered “the king’s court.”
